note: Attacker-controlled bytes are copied into a radio frame payload that will be injected into the OpenThread stack.
The crafted frame is delivered as if it were received from the radio, entering the packet-processing path.
The received CoAP request is dispatched to the matching resource handler based on its URI path.
The commissioning GET handler extracts requested TLVs from the attacker-controlled CoAP payload and forwards them for response construction.
The response builder iterates over the stored commissioning dataset and compares each nested TLV type against the requested type list.

A matching TLV is appended to the outgoing response by dereferencing the current TLV object; the crash hypothesis is that malformed or truncated commissioning data causes an out-of-bounds read here while walking the TLV chain.
